ActorTalk: Don't worry about me. I can't really help with this deep dive Asimov planned. I'll just wait here and enjoy the view.

Other than that, there's nothing special about me. If you want to ask more about Malkuth though...
Sorry, but that tech belongs to us. I'm sure you understand.
Thanks. I'll leave Rosetta and Malkuth in your hands.
Can you tell me a bit about yourself?
